not_a_claim_of: generalization beyond the BioASQ secondary snapshot

changed_components: candidate score adds the frozen direct A-C denominator 1 + n_AC
unchanged_components: eligible node, edge, bridge, and candidate sets
Decimal precision, ordering, quantization, and tie policy
all 21 case identities, kinds, cutoffs, and splits

freeze_timing.disclosure: The only revision was selected after all initial-formula development output was known. No revision-formula development output and no BioASQ held-out metric output existed at this freeze.

observed_initial_development_failure.scope: descriptive development measurement under the checksum-pinned initial formula
observed_initial_development_failure.support_sensitivity_observation: All 11 target scores and target bridge counts are identical between support 10 and support 5; candidate-universe denominators differ.
observed_initial_development_failure.interpretation: The initial development pattern is consistent with a generic association score that rewards structurally close controls; it does not establish the cause of failure and is not held-out validation.

revision_rationale.construct: A literature gap candidate should combine indirect A-B-C evidence with relative scarcity of direct A-C literature rather than rank generic association strength alone.
revision_rationale.single_change: Divide the unchanged indirect score by one plus the exact direct A-C article count.
revision_rationale.denominator_choice: The additive one is fixed additive-one smoothing: it keeps zero-direct candidates finite, uses no fitted parameter, and makes every additional direct article monotonically reduce the revised score.
revision_rationale.source_timing: Every case-level direct A-C count was already disclosed by the score-free source audit before the initial formula freeze; the feature is not sourced from held-out metric output.
revision_rationale.anti_tuning_boundary: No case kind, split, ontology relation, target identity, named bridge, development rank, or held-out metric output enters the formula. Held-out identities and source counts were known, as already disclosed. The exponent, additive constant, and functional form may not be tuned after this freeze.
revision_rationale.relation_to_lion: LION's retrospective evaluation removes direct A-C documents. This revision does not claim to reproduce that case-specific graph operation; it uses a simpler article-count penalty and reports the material difference.

graph_contract.candidate_set: For seed A, rank every C in V_t except A, including candidates with a direct A-C edge.
graph_contract.bridge_set: For a candidate C, use every B in V_t except A and C where n_AB > 0 and n_BC > 0.
graph_contract.direct_ac_count: n_AC is the exact number of included articles containing both A and C at the case cutoff; zero when the edge is absent.
graph_contract.direct_article_policy: Retain every A-C article in all support, edge, and bridge counts; use n_AC only through the frozen denominator.

score_contract.indirect_score: I(A,C) = sum(P(A,B,C) for B in bridge_set(A,C))
score_contract.monotonicity: At fixed indirect score, R is non-increasing in integer n_AC and equals I when n_AC is zero.
score_contract.candidate_direct_count_scope: Compute n_AC independently for every eligible candidate in the same cutoff graph; the named target receives no special handling.

numeric_reproducibility.arithmetic: Python decimal.Decimal only for every persisted score; native integer rational bounds may only screen rank comparisons and may not be persisted as scores.
numeric_reproducibility.indirect_evaluation: Evaluate every edge Jaccard from integer counts, take each path minimum, and sum in bridge order under the frozen context.
numeric_reproducibility.direct_penalty_evaluation: After the full indirect sum, construct Decimal(1 + n_AC) from the exact integer and perform one division under the frozen context.
numeric_reproducibility.persisted_score_rounding: quantize once after the direct-penalty division using ROUND_HALF_EVEN

ranking_contract.primary_orientation: rank target C conditioned on seed A
ranking_contract.candidate_order: persisted revised score descending, descriptor_ui ascending for display only

feature_exclusions: named target identity as a feature
named positive bridge identity as a feature
MeSH tree distance, parent, child, or sibling relationship
case-specific threshold, penalty, exponent, or candidate override

execution_isolation.allowed_revision_run: development cases only, at support 10 and 5
execution_isolation.heldout_prohibition: Do not compute, cache, log, persist, or preview any held-out score, rank, percentile, candidate ordering, or surfaced bridge list under the revision before a separately pinned finalization decision authorizes it.
execution_isolation.shared_graph_rule: Reuse the checksum-pinned case-blind graph only; revised scores and direct penalties remain development-case scoped.
execution_isolation.output_path_rule: Revision development output must use a new revision-contract-checksum-addressed path and refuse overwrite.
execution_isolation.no_further_revision: Any later change to source, threshold, graph, feature, score, numeric rule, or ranking terminates this pilot rather than creating revision 2.

pre_registered_revision_development_gate.evaluability_requirement: All 11 development cases must be evaluable at support 10 and 5; denominator shrinkage is forbidden.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.positive_requirement: At least 2 of 3 development source-labelled positives rank in the top 5 percent.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.hard_control_requirement: Zero of 4 development ontology-sibling hard controls ranks in the top 5 percent.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.distant_control_requirement: All 4 development cross-branch distant controls rank below the median, meaning rank_fraction > 0.5.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.sensitivity_requirement: All three requirements must hold at both support 10 and support 5; an unevaluable case or disagreement is not a pass.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.pass_action: Freeze this exact revision as final in a new checksum-pinned contract before one held-out execution.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.fail_action: Terminate the BioASQ v2 formula pilot before held-out execution and publish the development failure with zero readiness.
pre_registered_revision_development_gate.no_discretion_rule: Do not choose the initial formula, relax a threshold, reinterpret a control, or inspect held-out output after seeing the revision development result.

development_reporting: Report all 11 development cases at support 10 and 5 without denominator shrinkage.
For every case report endpoint supports, direct A-C count, indirect score, direct penalty, revised score, eligible candidate count, worst-tie rank, rank fraction, and top contributing B terms.
Report every pre-registered revision development gate component and the mechanically determined pass or fail action.
Keep source-labelled positives, ontology-generated controls, measured counts, and metric outputs structurally distinct.
Do not present revision development performance as held-out validation, discovery truth, metric-v3 readiness, or permission to add an LLM interpretation layer.
limitations: The revision was selected after inspecting all initial-formula development outputs and is not an independently chosen formula.
The additive-one direct penalty is a transparent heuristic, not an estimate of causal novelty or an exact LION implementation.
Held-out identities and source counts were known before the revision; held-out means metric-score-unseen, not analyst- or source-blinded.
Article-level MeSH co-occurrence differs materially from LION's sentence-level heterogeneous entity graph and case-specific direct-document removal.
Source-labelled positives are reproduction targets, not independently adjudicated discovery truth.
Ontology-generated controls are not verified absences of relationships, failed hypotheses, or non-academic knowledge.
The development population is only 11 cases and the pass gate is a routing rule, not a performance estimate.
The maintained 2013 MeSH vocabulary is not period-appropriate historical indexing, and the secondary snapshot is not the complete NLM baseline.
The snapshot omits or thins non-academic, practitioner, craft, indigenous, humanities, and historical knowledge.
No outcome contributes metric-v3 readiness, validates gap discovery, generalizes outside this pilot, or authorizes an LLM interpretation layer.
